nodes.text: You raise your eyes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: One thing to learn. One thing to take into next week. We'll work through it.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Alex stares back at the field.

nodes.speaker: Alex
nodes.text: We could've had that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Neither of you needs to pretend it feels satisfying. Code gathers the team before frustration turns into blame.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: We'll look at the chances we made and the ones we allowed. Both matter.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Sam reaches you, breathless.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That felt louder than last week.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Everything feels louder than last week.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Code gathers the team.

nodes.speaker: Coach Code
nodes.text: Enjoy it. Then we'll look at what we can repeat.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Winning has not answered whether Alex will stay. It has given you a result you earned together.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: As you shoulder your bag, Alex approaches.

nodes.speaker: Alex
nodes.text: Park sometime this week?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thought you had invitations.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Alex's expression changes. You realize how it sounded.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What time?

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Alex studies you for a moment. Then gives a small nod.

nodes.speaker: Alex
nodes.text: I'll message you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know if you're staying.

nodes.speaker: Alex
nodes.text: I don't know yet either. I'm still asking if you want to play.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: You nod.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah. I do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry. That came out wrong.

nodes.speaker: Alex
nodes.text: Yeah. It did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Park sounds good.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: Mom waits near the exit. Behind you, adults are still arguing about something that happened ten minutes ago.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: You look back once. Then catch up with her. The conversation—or the quiet—follows what you asked for on Thursday.

nodes.speaker: System
nodes.text: End of week 4.
